description: This file defines a Java interface for an Access Control List (ACL) system within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for managing ACL entries, permissions, and authorization subjects, as well as methods for JSON serialization and schema version support. The interface is deprecated, indicating it belongs to an older API version and has been superseded by newer policies.

classes.name: AccessControlList
classes.description: An interface representing an ACL system for associating authorization subjects with permissions. Supports modifications, permission queries, and JSON serialization. Deprecated in favor of newer API versions.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing an immutable AccessControlList.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder pre-initialized with the entries of the current ACL.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Indicates that this ACL is supported only in JsonSchemaVersion V_1.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Adds an entry to this ACL by merging its permissions with existing ones for the same authorization subject.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Creates an association between an authorization subject and permissions, merging with existing ones.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Creates entries associating a permission with authorization subjects, merging with existing associations.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Replaces or adds an ACL entry for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: setForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Sets a specified set of permissions for all authorization subjects, overwriting existing permissions.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsFor
methods.description: Retrieves authorization subjects associated with specific permissions.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if authorization context has at least the specified permissions.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if a specific authorization subject has at least the specified permissions.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsFor
methods.description: Retrieves authorization subjects for a set of expected permissions.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the ACL contains permissions for an authorization subject.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Gets the ACL entry for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: getPermissionsOf
methods.description: Retrieves all permissions associated with a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific ACL entry.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes specific permissions from an authorization subject's entry.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions associated with a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the ACL contains no entries.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the ACL.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a modifiable set of ACL entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a stream of ACL entries.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL to JSON, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ACL to JSON considering schema version and field selector.
